scripts.honey-economy:enable: wrangler d1 execute hivemindos_compute_gateway --remote --command "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO gateway_config(key,value,updated_at) VALUES('honey-economy-enabled','true',datetime('now'))"
scripts.honey-economy:disable: wrangler d1 execute hivemindos_compute_gateway --remote --command "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO gateway_config(key,value,updated_at) VALUES('honey-economy-enabled','false',datetime('now'))"
